thread:
Sam (AE): Evan from Clearwater wants a tight 30-day POC SOW to validate two workflows and pricing. Can SEs propose MVP journeys, acceptance criteria, security must-haves, and a draft timeline?
Priya (SE): MVP proposals:
  - Workflow A: Patient intake + triage (endpoint: POST /triage). Stateful, typical 3 turns, context <= 512 tokens.
  - Workflow B: Encounter summarization (endpoint: POST /summarize). Single-turn, structured JSON output: problem_list, assessment, plan.
Noah (SE): Acceptance metrics (proposal):
  - Triage: intent accuracy >= 0.85, critical-urgency recall >= 0.95 on 150 labeled dialogs.
  - Summary: BERTScore >= 0.65 and clinical-fact fidelity >= 0.90 on 200 notes.
  - Ops: p95 latency (dedicated) <= 700ms for triage; p50 <= 180ms for summaries; error rate <0.5%.
Lina (Security): must-haves: signed BAA/DPA, customer-managed KMS, SOC2, VPC peering option, data retention <=14 days for pilot. On-prem option possible but adds 3-6 weeks.
Evan (Buyer): confirmed BAA required and we prefer VPC. Need one-page SOW + cost estimate. Can we start with synthetic data?
Priya (SE): yes to synthetic for initial tuning. We'll need ~100 triage dialogs + 200 notes for reliable baselines. We'll provide prompt templates and a validation schema for summaries.
Noah (SE): timeline (tight 30-day):
  - Day 0: Sign SOW -> 48h env provision
  - Week 1: prompt collection + synthetic tuning
  - Week 2: eval runs & baseline metrics
  - Week 3: tuning + monitoring dashboards
  - Week 4: acceptance run & handoff
Sam (AE): commercial draft: 30-day Dedicated pilot, list cost estimate $12k, propose 35% pilot discount and option to convert to 3-month commit with additional discount. Evan: procurement contact?
Evan (Buyer): procurement is veronica@clearwater.org. We'll upload synthetic samples today and labeled data within 10 business days.
Sam (AE): action items:
  - Priya: produce POC runbook + acceptance spreadsheet (due EOD tomorrow)
  - Noah: scaffold eval harness + seed prompts (start today, 5 business days)
  - Lina: start BAA/DPA thread and send security checklist to Evan
  - Sam: draft SOW and cost snapshot and send invite for kickoff
Evan (Buyer): OK on kickoff next Wednesday 10am PT. Thanks everyone.
